name: solferino3-dashboard
description: Dashboard locale per Mac e Windows con link, strumenti e utility per il lavoro di agenzia

scripts.install-local: npm run dist && (pkill -x "Solferino 3 Dashboard" || true) && (pkill -x "Agency Dashboard SMM" || true) && sleep 2 && rm -rf "/Applications/Solferino 3 Dashboard.app" "/Applications/Agency Dashboard SMM.app" && ditto "dist/mac-universal/Solferino 3 Dashboard.app" "/Applications/Solferino 3 Dashboard.app" && xattr -cr "/Applications/Solferino 3 Dashboard.app" && open "/Applications/Solferino 3 Dashboard.app"
